provisional: Timing is estimated from the plan: no voice or take exists yet. Moment lengths follow the plan's estimates (5.5 / 2 / 4 / 3.5 / 4.5 / 3 / 4 s), shifted by up to 0.4 s (m2 2.1, m3 4.2, m4 3.6, m5 4.9, m6 2.7, m7 3.5) so that each drip beat lands in the moment the ledger gives it.

The drip beat of 4.4 s screen time is illustrative, as the plan's 'about 4 s' is. Its clock runs from 6.8 s. That first beat adds nothing because the bucket is still full, and later beats land at 11.2, 15.6, 20.0 and 24.4 s.
Presenter: visibility is undecided in the plan (m1 and m7), so the sketch draws no presenter stand-in.
The request rate limiter glyph is a labelled native placeholder, because its library artwork (cast-be8d129feaa5af3270de) is not in this packet.
The narration captions are for the sketch only: they show the draft lines from the plan's narration guide against the estimated timing.

Cast artwork is inlined and roughly recoloured: bucket, drop, requests and Redis icon use primary tints instead of accent; the 429 mark is redrawn as an accent badge. Tokens are separate native circles (re-rig), and the level stays inside the bucket's clip at the rig's extent.

token-hand-off and refusal-recoil are adapted recipes, roughed in here. The request route is straight keyframed x/y rather than the MotionPath technique, because the pinned runtime loads only gsap.min.js.
Other users' bucket levels are illustrative. So is the 'N' in the refill label: the creator has still to confirm that the drip rate equals the limiter's N.
Type uses the system sans and mono generics in place of the theme's Inter fallback, since the sketch ships no font files.
